enunciado.br: O plano passa por P(2, -1, 4) e tem vetor normal n = (1, 2, 3). Escrito como ax + by + cz = d, quanto vale d?
enunciado.fr: Le plan passe par P(2, -1, 4) et a pour vecteur normal n = (1, 2, 3). Écrit sous la forme ax + by + cz = d, combien vaut d ?
enunciado.en: The plane passes through P(2, -1, 4) and has normal vector n = (1, 2, 3). Written as ax + by + cz = d, what is d?
